title: kimura_landscape_v0 — RepeatMasker divsum payload
description: Output envelope from extractors.kimura_distance.extract. Each row in `buckets` is one K2P-divergence bucket (low div = recent TE activity, high div = ancient); `bp[k]` is the bp annotated at that bucket for the k-th family in `families`. The age-landscape area chart on page_comparative_te is rendered directly from this payload. Note: small negative `bp` values (-1, -3, -14, -23 in the chapter-5 corpus) are RepeatMasker rounding artifacts on low-coverage buckets — not data corruption.

families.description: Family names from the `.distance` header row, in column order.

buckets.description: One row per K2P-divergence bucket. `bp` is parallel to `families`.
